$comment: Machine-readable encoding of the Penpot library structure described in design/penpot/README.md. Penpot cannot be driven from this repo (no network, no API access); this file is the authoritative spec so later tooling or a human operator can apply the structure programmatically. Keep in sync with penpot/README.md and penpot-map.json.

libraries.name: VS Code UI Reference
libraries.purpose: imported Webview UI Toolkit (@vscode/webview-ui-toolkit) frames kept for visual/behavioral reference during extraction
libraries.editorial: conceptually read-only in Penpot; never edit; never a source for production design; product code never imports the toolkit (PRINCIPLES.md rule 2)

pages.name: Toolkit Reference
pages.contains: original @vscode/webview-ui-toolkit component visuals mapped to --vscode-* variables

libraries.name: Obra Design System
libraries.purpose: the single library production UI is designed from; component ids must match design/penpot-map.json

pages.name: 03 Templates
pages.containsNotes: page skeletons composed only from 01 Primitives and 02 Patterns (e.g. Stack-based forms, list + detail); the Stack layout primitive itself (obra/stack) also lives here

pages.name: 04 Product Surfaces
pages.containsNotes: named production surfaces from UX contracts per design/SURFACE_RULES.md (surface ids like cost-control, company-view, project-view); conceptual-only ids such as obra/property-panel live here as placeholders until they export from @obra/ui

pages.name: 05 Explorations
pages.containsNotes: working area; nothing here is authoritative or referenced as production

syncDirection: packages/obra-ui/src/index.ts -> design/penpot-map.json -> Penpot component ids -> stories
